eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

constructor.notice: Creates an escrow owned by `initialOwner`; owner is guardian, relayer, and policy by default.

domainSeparator().notice: EIP-712 domain separator for off-chain relayers.

executeSlash(bytes32).notice: Executes an unvetoed slash after its challenge window.

hashVerdict((bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uin.notice: EIP-712 digest signed by `verifier` for a settlement verdict.

pause().notice: Pauses staking, recording, settlement, and slash execution/proposal.

proposeSlash((bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,by.notice: Opens a slash challenge proposed by the registered verifier.

providerId(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Deterministic key for a provider/profile pair.

recordDeposit(bytes32,bytes32,address,ui.notice: Attributes a mirror-confirmed variant-A deposit without accepting value in this call.

registerProvider(bytes32,bytes32,address.notice: Registers a provider/profile pair and its operator.

requestUnstake(uint256,bytes32,bytes32).notice: Starts unbonding stake while leaving the provider above its required stake.

setChallengeWindow(uint256).notice: Changes slash challenge window within fixed safety bounds.

setPendingAudits(bytes32,bytes32,uint256.notice: Sets pending audit count for withdrawal gating.

setPolicy(address).notice: Rotates the policy authority for required-stake updates.

setRelayer(address).notice: Rotates the trusted variant-A deposit relayer.

setRequiredStake(bytes32,uint256,bytes32.notice: Sets the profile's required stake from the configured policy authority.

setUnbondingPeriod(uint256).notice: Changes unbonding period within fixed safety bounds.

setVerifier(address,bytes32).notice: Rotates the verifier key used for settlement signatures and slash proposals.

settle((bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,uint8,by.notice: Applies a batch of EIP-712 verifier-signed settlement verdicts.

stake().notice: Adds stake for the provider/profile operated by `msg.sender`.

vetoSlash(bytes32,string).notice: Public guardian veto of a pending slash with a non-private reason string.

withdraw(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Withdraws a matured unstake when no audits or slash challenges are open.
